title: Explanation
description: Output of the Explanation Agent. Plain-English justification of why a case is suspicious.

case_id.description: Reference to the case being explained.

explanation_text.description: 3-5 sentence plain-English explanation citing pattern + anomaly + risk score.

type.description: What kind of evidence this citation references.

citations.description: Every claim in explanation_text must have at least one citation.

confidence.description: Agent's confidence in the explanation (0.0 = low, 1.0 = high).
